sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (9 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) from PMC11170479 describe a C-terminal FLAG tag on chick Cx50 (GJA8), with Cx46 (GJA3) constructs used in the same study. The connexin C-terminus is unambiguously intracellular: topology landmarks place residues 223–435 of GJA3 in the cytoplasm. A C-terminal tag on GJA3 would therefore face the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface. The two extracellular loops of GJA3 (ECL1: 43–71; ECL2: 174–201) are not addressed by any ledger line with a tolerated insertion. No ledger line supports an extracellular tag insertion on GJA3, so sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal FLAG tag appended to Cx50 (and Cx46 constructs) in PMC11170479; the connexin C-terminus is intracellular (topology residues 223–435 for GJA3), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
